headline: Reflections, from entry to detail
overview: Reflections is a central journal that aggregates written reflections from every module across the app — gratitude entries, coaching notes, wolf reflection logs, breakthrough check-ins, and more. Instead of hunting through individual tools for past thoughts, you can see your entire reflective writing history in one place, searchable and filterable by source, date, or theme.
targetAudience: Users interested in growth tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Reflections — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface, with the unified journal feed aggregating reflections from all modules.

keyFeatures: Unified journal feed aggregating reflections from every module in the app
Filter by source module, date range, or search by content
Chronological timeline of your entire reflective writing history
Quick links back to the source module for each reflection entry
tips: Use Reflections for a periodic review — reading a month of entries at once reveals patterns you'd miss day by day
Filter by a specific module to trace how your thinking on a topic has evolved over time
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
